name: Camden
gaps: Parcels are Parcels FeatureServer/1 (PRIMARY county AGOL CAMA + owner/sale-date/zoning attr) (https://services7.arcgis.com/f8vjF7CsMeTPBIVC/arcgis/rest/services/Parcels/FeatureServer/1). Acreage is 5.0–150.0 inclusive. No Opportunity Zone status, school grade, or base flood elevation is stored.
Source query returned 1997 rows; 1978 stayed in the 5.0–150.0 acre band after the parcel-id and geometry checks.
Pass 2 enrichment is from card pass2 (tax gap, sale partial). Pass 2 counted 102 NCDOT 2022 AADT stations. NCDOT AADT stays the query-time statewide join.
Pass 2 tax status is gap. Scrubbed or missing tax values were not copied off the parcel layer.
Pass 2 sale: SaleDate (string) on layer; no price on REST. Price only on NCPTS https://lrcpwa.ncptscloud.com/camden/parcel-detail/{PIN} (script-rendered SPA).
This county is not on the rural Opportunity Zone pass-1 table. It fills the batch after Rutherford through Wilkes.
Non-OZ fill. Usable county parcel card; not on the rural Opportunity Zone pass-1 table.
Property-appraiser links are stored from the card or pass-2 pattern and were not requested. Owner phone and email are not ingested.
